result:
All deliverables are in place. The pipeline successfully demonstrates both theta phenomena on real DANDI data.

**Summary of results from `Achilles_10252013` (DANDI:000044, Grosmark & Buzsáki 2016):**

- 120 pyramidal cells → **34 place cells** (peak ≥ 2 Hz, SI ≥ 0.7 bits/spike)
- **Theta entrainment**: 28/34 (82%) of place cells significantly locked to theta (Rayleigh p<0.05); pooled population mean phase ≈ 149°
- **Phase precession**: 26/33 cells (79%) show negative phase-vs-position slope; 19/33 (58%) significant; mean slope **−1.48 rad/field**, mean circular-linear ρ **+0.26**

**Files produced:**
- `theta_analysis.py` (jupytext) — end-to-end pipeline
- `theta_analysis.ipynb` — converted notebook
- `figures/01–07*.png` — behavior, LFP, PSD, place fields, entrainment, precession examples, precession population
- `README.md` — dataset description, methods, results, reproduction recipe
